study: HP-SPGG Claim B v3 confirmatory contraction study

relationship_to_prior_work.original_scaling_run: Retained as a preregistered null; it is not overwritten or pooled into this study.
relationship_to_prior_work.v2_pilot: Used only to design this independent confirmatory study; pilot seeds 2000-2199 are excluded.
relationship_to_prior_work.claim_correction: The original (n+1) log(m)/(rho H) formula is retired. Proposition prop:tid-collapse is per-agent. The confirmatory target is log(m*pi_min^(-1/2))/(rho H) per agent, with an additional log(n)/(rho H) only for simultaneous all-agent concentration.

theory_target.primary: Under the stochastic Gaussian per-agent outcome channel, expected square-root posterior odds contract by the product of Hellinger affinities; cumulative posterior-sampling type error is K-independent.
theory_target.operational_secondary: First-passage episodes to posterior true-type mass > 0.9 increase with log(m*pi_min^(-1/2))/(rho_action*H); simultaneous all-agent first passage adds log(n)/(rho_action*H), not a linear n term.

dgp.type_family: nested prefixes of the existing respaced m=16 analytic type library
dgp.type_family_reason: Adjacent spacing, action-specific rho, and full-grid rho are identical for every m, separating library-size effects from rho.
dgp.outcome: For each episode, the sufficient sample mean is drawn independently as Normal(mu_true, sigma/sqrt(H)); this is exactly equivalent for Bayesian updating to H independent Normal(mu_true,sigma) turns.

randomization.independence: Every (phase,n,m,H) cell receives a distinct RNG stream. H cells are not regroupings of one turn stream.

affinity_core.estimand: -log of the empirical mean square-root likelihood ratio versus turns times -log(1-rho_pair)

adaptive_robustness.role: A separately reported robustness gate; it does not replace the fixed-channel identification experiment.

analysis.censoring: No complete-case deletion. First passages are analyzed as restricted values min(T,max_episodes+1); the censoring fraction is a hard gate.
analysis.uncertainty: Nonparametric bootstrap resampling independent seed clusters within each cell; agents from one seed remain together.
analysis.type_horizon_fit: OLS across 28 prespecified cell restricted means against log(m*sqrt(m))/(rho_action*H).
analysis.population_fit: OLS across six prespecified cell restricted all-agent means against [log(m*sqrt(m))+log(n)]/(rho_action*H).
analysis.original_formula_comparator: The same six population means are also fit against (n+1)*log(m)/(rho_action*H); this comparator is diagnostic and cannot rescue a failed corrected fit.
analysis.posterior_error_proxy: H times the sum over episodes of 1-posterior_mass(true type), evaluated before each episode update.

decision_rule: Claim B-v3 is supported only if G1 through G5 all pass without changing the grid, seeds, thresholds, estimands, censor handling, or cutoffs. Otherwise it remains unsupported and every failed gate is reported.
paper_policy: Do not modify LaTeX until the locked confirmatory run and independent validator complete.
